column4: heten means to be called; "to heat" is a mistaken meaning (the verb is "heet maken/verhitten") and duplicates "to heat up".'
heten does not mean to heat up; this is not a real meaning of the word.
To emerge (as a result) largely duplicates the other meanings (to figure out, to add up/come out right) and is vague.
A compound prefix is not a meaning of the noun 'kern' and is already covered by the nucleus and core meanings.
The archaic 'wrath' sense of gram is obscure and only confuses a learner.
'Del' for a dune valley is a rare regional term that is hardly used in everyday Dutch, so it only confuses a learner.
blend and "mix" are the same meaning of de mix, so this duplicates the other entry.
'Slightly' and 'somewhat' are the same meaning of enigszins, so the two entries duplicate each other.
Het potlood means pencil, not graphite powder, so this meaning does not exist and the real meaning is already listed.
The 'force' sense of zweep is archaic and confusing, and the main meaning 'whip' is already listed.
This sense duplicates the other meaning 'bale of hay', which is just a specific case of a bale.
'Slee' does not mean stiff; this sense is dubious and the real meaning (dull, stale) is covered by the other entry.
This meaning duplicates the other "beech" meaning, which already covers the tree.
The 'orphan' meaning is archaic and rare, and would confuse learners, so it is dropped while the pupil meanings remain.
Both entries mean 'to go wrong' (fail), so this duplicates the other meaning.

column3: leg of a piece of furniture
column4: Voetstuk means pedestal or base and does not mean furniture leg, so this meaning is invalid and pedestal is already listed as another meaning.
The 'stupid' meaning for wicht is not attested as a noun and only confuses learners; the real meanings are child and girl.
'To retract' is essentially the same meaning as 'to revoke', so it duplicates the other meaning.

This meaning 'twisted' is already covered by the other sense listed as 'wry' only loosely, but the physical twisted sense is the core and 'wry' is the duplicate-flagged figurative; dropping this would lose the main sense, so keep is better.
'Industrial bond' is not a meaning of 'industrieel' as a noun; the only noun sense is industrialist, which is already listed.
This figurative 'heir apparent' sense is a minor extension of the main crown prince meaning, so it largely duplicates it.
This archaic meaning, a deputy or bailiff's assistant, is obscure and only confuses learners; the 'rascal' meaning is the one in real use.
'Sneeuwen' as an adjective meaning snow white is not natural Dutch ('sneeuwwit' is used), and the verb is the real word, so this adjective meaning is confusing.
The adjective 'sneeuwen' is not a normal word (the usual forms are 'besneeuwd' or 'sneeuw-'), and the example is unnatural, so the entry only confuses learners.
Underling is essentially a repeat of subordinate, which is already listed as the other meaning.
Noodweer in the legal sense is 'de' and is already covered by item 3, so this duplicates it (and the example is unnatural).
'Exuberant' is not a meaning of malloot, which means fool; this sense is invented and duplicates nothing real.
The 'burning' sense is not real; zonnebrand means sunburn, which is already listed, and the example is unnatural.
The 'building' sense duplicates the existing 'building premises' meaning, and is marked archaic.
wegvliegen does not mean 'to flee'; the only real meaning is 'to fly away', which is already listed.
Groeve means pit or quarry, and "open grave" is a rare, doubtful sense (a grave is graf), so it only confuses learners.
Meaning 'to reconcile' duplicates the 'te rijmen met' sense already covered in item 1.
It duplicates the other meaning 'banishment', which is the same sense.
'Any swill' is not a real meaning of gier and is a garbled duplicate of the liquid manure sense.
'Caprice' is an obscure, archaic sense of gier that would only confuse a learner.
'Gyre' is not a meaningful sense of gier for a learner and is obscure and archaic.
This meaning duplicates the other 'gland (secretory structure)' meaning, while the separate slang meaning 'obnoxious person' is kept.
This meaning duplicates the other 'gland' meaning, so it adds nothing.
Binnenbrengen does not mean 'to come in'; that is binnenkomen, so this meaning does not exist.
It duplicates the other meaning 'dialect (language variety)'.
This duplicates the other meaning 'compartment', which already covers the train compartment sense.
Kwaal means ailment, not agony; the 'agony' sense does not exist and the other meaning already covers it.
'Lijmen' meaning 'to sing' is not a real meaning of this word (probably a confusion with 'zingen'), so it does not exist.
The archaic 'mite' sense is obscure and only confuses learners.
Rein meaning clean duplicates the other meaning "pure" (clean/pure are the same sense), so drop this repeat.
hollen does not mean to strike; this sense is a mistaken or obscure and confusing entry.
hollen meaning to drag is not a real current meaning and would only confuse a learner.
Duplicates the meaning to hollow out (to make hollow).
hollen does not mean to rage; the meaning does not exist and the other listed meanings cover the real senses.
Beamen does not mean 'to say' in a way distinct from the assent meaning, so this is a duplicate or a mistaken sense.
Werkloosheid means unemployment, so this 'shortage of work' meaning duplicates the other meaning.
A salt container meaning of keet is not real or standard, so it only confuses learners.
The meaning 'movement at a slow pace' duplicates the other meaning 'slow motion'.
The meaning 'fabric used for painting' merely repeats the other meaning 'canvas'.
The 'execution' meaning is archaic and confusing, and 'delivery' remains as the real meaning.
'Gratuitous' is just a repeat of the 'unfounded' sense, not a distinct meaning of ongegrond.
'Specious' is not a separate meaning of ongegrond and duplicates 'unfounded'.
The archaic 'transgression' sense is obscure and only confuses learners; the 'digression' sense is listed elsewhere.
A 'bruised egg' sense is not a real separate meaning of kneus; the word means a bruise or a loser, and the example is unnatural.
Kneus does not mean 'violation'; this meaning does not exist and the example is invented.
Dutch 'lier' is the lyre and winch; the hurdy-gurdy is a 'draailier', so this meaning is wrong or at best obscure.
A 'bar of iron' is not a real meaning of bout; the example is wrong, and the iron/soldering-iron sense is covered by another item.
The obscure botanical sense (Gnaphalium dioicum) only confuses a learner, while the common meaning 'rosary' is listed among the others.
Virginity and youth as meanings of rozenkrans are obscure figurative senses that only confuse a learner, and they are not a real everyday meaning.
Youth is not an actual meaning of rozenkrans in current Dutch and is an obscure, confusing sense.
Bowling lane duplicates bowling alley, the other listed meaning of the same word.
The 'assistant leader' sense is not a real meaning of vaandrig and is not standard usage.
This meaning duplicates the 'black-crowned night heron' meaning listed among the other meanings.
Rare back-neckline sense is obscure and overlaps with the main décolleté meaning, so it only confuses learners.
The archaic sense 'to go away' is obscure and confusing; modern afwijken means to deviate, which is already listed.
Fire captain and fire chief are near-synonyms for the same rank, so this duplicates the other meaning.
Archaic schizophrenia-type sense duplicates the general meaning autism and only confuses learners.
Kicker is not a real meaning of klomp; wooden shoe and clump are already listed.
The archaic tuberculosis meaning only confuses learners, and the example is unnatural.
The meaning 'inexorable' is not a genuine sense of dwangmatig and would only confuse learners.
'Relentless' is only a loose variant of the compulsive sense, which is already listed, so it duplicates it.
The idiom means 'to die' or colloquially 'to give up/quit' only loosely; the give-up sense is not standard and the example is dubious, so drop this duplicate meaning.
impulse as a short push duplicates the other meanings (impetus/thrust) and the example is awkward.
The gloss 'portion' is wrong for woonruimte, and the real meaning 'living space' is already listed, so this is a bad duplicate.
Indonesia is not a true synonym of the colonial name Indië and the example is misleading; the meaning is covered by the Dutch East Indies sense.
'To bake completely' duplicates the other meaning 'to bake thoroughly'.
Ogenschijnlijk means seeming, not clear; this 'clear' sense does not exist, and the other entry covers the real meaning.
Het middaguur is essentially the midday hour, and this meaning largely duplicates the other entry for midday, with a forced example.
The sense of bastard is archaic and offensive, and the word is now used for outsider, which is already listed.
Ampul meaning 'small jug' is an obscure/archaic sense; the standard meaning ampoule is already listed.
A 'protective ship part' is not a real meaning of zandloper (it also means a sand-runner beetle or a sandpiper-like bird at most), so it is obscure and confusing.
'Pleasantness' is a rare figurative use that largely overlaps with the sweetness meaning and the example is odd for learners.
The scientific-name gloss merely duplicates the other meaning 'ostrich'.
This meaning, a glass of mineral water, is covered by the other meaning of mineral water, so it duplicates it.
It duplicates the other meaning 'stork', which refers to the same bird.
'To be interested' is not a real meaning of tippelen and the example is invented.
'To fall' is an obscure archaic sense with no example that only confuses learners.
Tippelen meaning 'to steal' is not a real meaning; it is not attested and would confuse a learner.
